newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore sees economy growing about 2.6 pct Q496.
newsitem.headline: Singapore sees economy growing about 2.6 pct Q496.

text.p: Singapore's economy is likely to grow by about 2.6 percent year-on-year in the fourth quarter of 1996, a Ministry of Trade and Industry official said on Friday.
He was speaking at a briefing for reporters after the release of third quarter economic figures.

Those statistics showed the economy grew 11.4 percent in the first quarter of 1996, by 7.5 percent in the second and by 3.2 percent in the third. The ministry forecast growth for the year as a whole at about six percent.
Using these figures, a growth of 1.9 percent could be derived for the fourth quarter.
But MTI officials said this could be conservative.
"If you actually calculate the level, actually we are talking about 2.6," he said.
